episode_summary: In this episode, Kelsey Caputo discusses the integration of AI in real estate, particularly in the luxury market of the Florida Keys. She emphasizes the irreplaceable value of local knowledge and transparency in building trust with high-net-worth clients. Kelsey shares actionable insights on using AI to anticipate client objections and create targeted marketing strategies, making a compelling case for why AI should be seen as a tool rather than a threat.
